response_property_constraints.description: The object type must be the literal string 'playlist'.
The collaborative field must be a boolean value (true if the owner allows other users to modify the playlist).
The playlist's public/private status must be a boolean value (true=public, false=private) or null.
The Spotify URI of the playlist must follow the Spotify URI format starting with 'spotify:playlist:'.
The href must be a link to the Web API endpoint providing full details of the playlist (a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL).
The external_urls object, when present, should contain a 'spotify' key whose value is a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL.
The owner object type must be the literal string 'user'.
The Spotify URI for the owner user must follow the format starting with 'spotify:user:'.
The followers object must contain a 'total' integer representing the total number of followers.
